summary: Tested SmartTally affiliate custom pricing end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (eligibility, create validations 400/409/409/200, list + 403, resend, PATCH 200/400/404, public invite 200/404, signup with invite -> referred_by + signup_firm_slug + priced doc signed_up, company billing/state custom_pricing, checkout-session monthly+annual -> checkout.stripe.com, custom_pricing with no priced doc -> 400). Frontend: Clients tab shown for affiliate.smarttally and hidden for pro; add client $180 -> 'Invite sent', row 'you keep $50.00/mo' Invited; edit to $200 -> row $200.00; resend -> 'Invite re-sent'; edit below floor -> error toast. Invite signup badge shows Sam Seller/Advanced/$200.00; after signup /welcome/pricing shows single custom card ($200, Your plan, correct headline/sub), annual toggle shows $166.67/mo billed $2,000/year, Start 7-day free trial redirected to checkout.stripe.com. Jamie shows $165 custom card. Core feature works; issues below are logic edge cases from code review plus minor UX.

critical.issue: Cadence mismatch: client can choose annual at checkout while priced doc keeps cadence='monthly' (doc cadence is never updated on checkout completion). custom_share_cents uses doc.cadence to compute floor -> floor=13000 vs gross=monthly*10, so affiliate would be credited (annual - $130) instead of (annual - $1300). Over-payout of ~$1,170/yr per client. Fix: stamp the chosen billing_cadence (session.metadata.billing_cadence) onto affiliate_priced_clients.cadence in checkout completion, or derive floor from the invoice's price interval.

Same root cause: for a subscription bought annually but doc.cadence='monthly', price change swaps the sub item to a monthly price_data (interval switch + wrong amount), and companies.sub_amount_cents set to monthly. Use the live subscription item's recurring.interval instead of doc.cadence.

minor.issue: Invite token is not checked against the signup email — anyone with the link can sign up with a different email and consume the priced invite. Consider requiring email match (or at least logging).
Signup link query params (email, name) are not URL-encoded — emails with '+' or names with '&' produce broken links. Use urllib.parse.urlencode.

doc.setdefault('referred_by_user_id', ...) keeps a pre-existing ref-cookie referrer over the invite's affiliate; _credit_referral_share override by stripe_subscription_id mitigates this only after webhook stamps sub id.

ui_bugs.issue: Price input has min=130 so browser native validation ('Value must be greater than or equal to 130.') blocks submit; the custom $130 minimum error toast never shows. Functionally acceptable, but if toast is required add noValidate to the form.

issues: Subtitle 'Free to start — you can upgrade any time.' contradicts the custom paid-plan invite badge; header brand shows 'SmartBooks LEDGER' rather than SmartTally on platform host.
pricing-custom-sub always says '$X/mo' even when Annual toggle selected (card correctly shows annual) — fine but could mention annual total.
Header brand inconsistent: new invited client sees 'SmartTally', Jamie (same signup_firm_slug smarttally) sees 'SmartBooks Team'.
Login lands on /owner rather than /welcome/pricing — verify the pricing gate redirects invited unpaid clients.

action_items: HIGH: Persist chosen checkout cadence to affiliate_priced_clients on checkout.session.completed (or derive from subscription interval) so custom_share_cents floor and PATCH price updates use the actual billing interval
Optionally enforce invite email == signup email
Optional: noValidate on add-client form so the $130 toast shows; fix signup subtitle copy for invites
critical_code_review_comments: custom_share_cents and _update_subscription_price both rely on doc.cadence which is set by the affiliate at invite time, but the client chooses cadence freely at checkout
_refresh_status does DB writes inside a GET list call per row — fine at 500 rows but N+1 queries
ClientRow price input state is not reset from props after reload (stale value if price changed elsewhere)

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 tests); 2 HIGH code-review logic bugs untestable without completing payment
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; $130 toast pre-empted by native validation)

seed_data_creation: Created priced clients + users: qa.custom.af700f3b@example.com (pytest, signed up, company TEST_QA Custom Co) and qa.custom.ui18102@example.com / Test1234! (UI, $200, signed up, company TEST_QA UI Biz). Stripe test checkout sessions created, none paid.

Invite token from mongo affiliate_priced_clients.invite_token. Clients tab testids: share-tab-clients, affiliate-add-client-btn, add-client-*, priced-client-{edit,save,resend,price-input}-<id>. Pricing: pricing-custom-grid, pricing-card-custom, pricing-cadence-annual, pricing-select-custom.
